tasks.title: Automate PDF Invoice & Receipt Extraction to Accounting Sheet
tasks.description: Build an automated pipeline that monitors inbound billing emails, extracts invoice numbers, vendor, line items, and VAT via LLM vision, and appends them to Google Sheets/BigQuery.
tasks.priorityRationale: High frequency recurring administrative bottleneck. Automating this eliminates 12 hours/month of tedious manual data entry.
tasks.feasibilityReasoning: 100% solvable with Cloudflare Email Routing + Workers AI (Llama 3.2 Vision / OCR) + Google Sheets API.

strategy: 1. Bind Cloudflare Email Worker to inbound billing inbox.
2. Pipe PDF attachment buffers into Workers AI OCR parser.
3. Extract structured JSON schema: { vendor, invoice_date, total, vat, items }.
4. Upsert row into Google Sheets Accounting ledger via Service Account REST API.
5. Notify user via Telegram/Discord with summary & one-click approve link.
bestPractices: Buffer single-use raw email stream before processing.
Use idempotent hash on invoice number to prevent duplicate rows.
Store raw PDF into Cloudflare R2 bucket as an audit trail.

webInspiration.title: Open-Source Invoice Parser using Vision LLMs
webInspiration.keyTakeaway: Zero-shot schema parsing is 98% more reliable than traditional regex/tesseract OCR.

webInspiration.title: Cloudflare Email Routing Best Practices
webInspiration.keyTakeaway: Use email workers with postal-mime for streaming attachment extraction.

tasks.title: Deploy Real-Time Competitor Pricing & Feature Scraper
tasks.description: Schedule an automated scraper that checks competitor SaaS pricing tiers, feature additions, and changelogs every Sunday morning and generates a brief executive summary.
tasks.priorityRationale: Keeps leadership proactively informed of market movements without manual site browsing.
tasks.feasibilityReasoning: Playwright / Puppeteer script running on Sandbox Linux VM with LLM diff summarization.

strategy: 1. Headless browser crawls 5 target competitor pricing URLs.
2. Extract DOM snapshot and compare with cached HTML hash.
3. If diff detected, feed text changes to Gemini/Claude for strategic summary.
4. Post markdown bullet briefing directly to Work Hub and Email.
bestPractices: Run browser in isolated Parallels Sandbox VM (`sandbox-vm`) to protect host.
Include backoff and randomized delay to prevent rate-limiting.

webInspiration.title: Serverless Playwright Scraper Patterns
webInspiration.keyTakeaway: Extract text-only DOM tree before sending to LLM to save 85% token cost.

wikiArticles.title: 📱 Voice AI HUD & "Hello Google" Mobile PWA Experience
wikiArticles.summary: How to use real-time voice recognition, tactile push-to-talk, spoken TTS audio responses, and install the PWA onto iOS and Android home screens.
wikiArticles.content:
## Overview
The **Voice AI HUD** brings a futuristic "Hello Google / Siri" conversational experience directly to your phone and desktop.

### Key Features
- **Fluid Audio Visualizer**: A dynamic canvas orb and reactive sine waveforms that pulse in sync with your speech amplitude.
- **Continuous & Push-to-Talk Listening**: Web Speech API with Web Audio Voice Activity Detection.
- **Natural Voice Feedback (TTS)**: Instant synthesized spoken confirmations for all commands.
- **Interactive Action Cards**: Dynamic cards appearing on screen for 1-click execution (Send Email, Add to Calendar, Dial Contact).

### Mobile PWA Installation
1. Open `http://<host>:5173` in Safari (iOS) or Chrome (Android).
2. Tap the **Share** button on iOS -> **Add to Home Screen**.
3. The Assistant runs full-screen as a native standalone app with offline resilience.

### iOS Shortcuts & Apple Watch Integration
- Dedicated ingest endpoint: `POST /api/voice/ingest`
- Create an iOS Shortcut with "Record Audio" -> "URL: /api/voice/ingest" -> "Method: POST (Multipart)" to capture voice memos directly from your lock screen Action Button!
wikiArticles.author: AI Assistant

wikiArticles.title: ⚡ Autonomous Executive Actions: Emails, Calendar & Calls
wikiArticles.summary: Natural language speech patterns for instant email drafting, conflict-aware meeting bookings, and contact communications.
wikiArticles.content:
## Overview
Instead of just taking notes, the Assistant directly executes executive tasks through natural voice intent parsing.

### 1. Email Assistant
- **Example Commands**: *"Draft an email to Sarah regarding Q3 growth sprint"*, *"Send an email to David with our updated pricing plan"*.
- **Behavior**: Matches contacts, generates polished structured drafts with context-aware subjects, and provides 1-click **Send Email Now**.

### 2. Calendar & Appointment Coordinator
- **Example Commands**: *"Book a strategy sync with David Miller next Tuesday at 2 PM"*, *"Schedule dentist appointment tomorrow at 10 AM"*.
- **Conflict Detection**: Automatically scans your calendar schedule and warns of overlaps.
- **Google Calendar Sync**: Generates 1-tap Google Calendar web links and standard `.ics` event feeds.
- **Rescheduling**: Say *"Reschedule Friday sync to Monday 10 AM"* or tap **Move +1 Day**.

### 3. Contact Calls
- **Example Commands**: *"Call Sarah Chen"*, *"Dial David Miller"*.
- Automatically matches phone numbers and renders a 1-tap direct dialer button (`tel:`).
wikiArticles.author: AI Assistant

wikiArticles.title: 📊 Monday.com-Style Work Hub & Dual-Priority Framework
wikiArticles.summary: How speech transcripts are dissected into categorized tasks, evaluated with Dual Priority (User vs AI), and scored for Feasibility.
wikiArticles.content:
## Overview
The Work Hub organizes all extracted ideas and action items into a clean, collapsible Monday.com-style spreadsheet.

### 1. Multi-Dimensional Taxonomy
Tasks are categorized into 7 core business domains:
- **Tech/Dev**, **Business & Strategy**, **Finance**, **Operations & Admin**, **Marketing & Sales**, **Client Projects**, and **Personal & Health**.

### 2. Dual-Priority Comparison
- **User Priority**: Your subjective urgency (Urgent, High, Medium, Low).
- **AI Priority**: Objective leverage assessment based on recurring hours won back and automation feasibility.
- **Eisenhower 2x2 Matrix**: Quadrants for Execute Now, Automate Blueprint, Human Action, and Backlog.

### 3. Feasibility Classification
- `🤖 AI-Automated`: Solvable via scripts, Cloudflare Workers, scrapers, or APIs.
- `👤 Human-Only`: Requires physical presence, face-to-face negotiation, or legal signatures.
- `⚡ Hybrid`: AI generates 90% of the draft/system; human provides review and final approval.

### 4. Hours Won Back & ROI Metrics
- Tracks cumulative recurring hours saved vs hours invested to automate, calculating your **Automation ROI Multiplier**.

wikiArticles.title: 🤖 Self-Teaching Automation Studio & Web Research Hub
wikiArticles.summary: How the AI formulates step-by-step automation blueprints, generates starter code, and scans the web for best-practice solutions.
wikiArticles.content:
## Overview
Every task tagged as AI-Automated or Hybrid automatically receives an **Automation Blueprint**.

### Blueprint Components
1. **Step-by-Step AI Strategy**: Concrete sequential plan to automate the task.
2. **Tool & API Recommendations**: Headless browsers, Cloudflare Workers, Python scripts, OCR engines, etc.
3. **Executable Code Generator**: Pre-built starter scripts in TypeScript, Python, or Bash with syntax highlighting and 1-click copy.
4. **Web Research Best Practices**: Researched open-source repositories and architectural tips with direct documentation links.
5. **Sandbox VM Execution Runner**: Test and validate automation scripts in the isolated Linux VM (`sandbox-vm`) before pushing live!

wikiArticles.title: 🔒 System Architecture & Parallels Sandbox VM (10.211.55.6)
wikiArticles.summary: Security architecture, host protection rules, Parallels VM execution bridge, and cross-machine synchronization.
wikiArticles.content:
## Overview
The system operates under a strict **Universal Operational Profile** to protect the host machine and ensure high performance.

### Security & Environment Invariants
- **macOS Host**: Low-privilege, strictly protected. No heavy dev servers, build tasks, or raw npm installs locally.
- **Parallels Linux VM (`sandbox-vm`)**: Dedicated Ubuntu VM at `10.211.55.6` running builds, test runners, Docker, and terminal executions via SSH bridge.
- **Command Execution Rule**: Terminal tasks run via `ssh sandbox-vm "<command>"`.
- **Global Skills Hub**: Universal skills located in `~/.gemini/antigravity/skills/` and tracked on `main` branch.
- **Project Memory (`AGENTS.md`)**: Persistent repository guidelines and invariant rules in project root.
